pages.text: $(bold)Meat Mincer$(): right-click with items to add ingredients (single slot).$(br)With the right recipe, right-click with a $(bold)mincer cover$() to seal it and start mincing - a wrong recipe won't consume the cover.$(br2)Batches continue automatically until the output is full; $(bold)shift-right-click$() unseals and refunds materials and cover, then right-click with an empty hand to collect the results.
